summary: Tight re-test of the iteration_45 action items. ALL FIVE FIXES VERIFIED WORKING. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_iteration46_currency_fixes.py - 10/12 pass; the 2 failures are a NEW defect found in Admin > Ledger / Admin dashboard stats (same mixed-currency anti-pattern). The full iteration-45 regression suite still passes 23/23 (checkout forced USD, PayPal amount, door takings USD, walk-in cash sale, QR redeem + double-redeem rejection, membership refund guard). Frontend Playwright as member, admin and partner: (1) My orders now shows the historical INR order as ₹1,592 and its cancellation sheet also ₹1,592 and its invoice is INR - all three agree; USD orders show $6.96. (2) Admin > Vendor settlements cards read USD 0.00 / USD 22.80 / USD 38.40 / USD 15.29 while rows stay INR 1,900.00 etc. (3) Vendor portal > Settlements shows SETTLED $38.40 / PENDING $22.80 with ₹ rows - admin and vendor now agree exactly. (4) Checkout credit sub-line reads '$5.96 applied · $10.08 left in your wallet' matching 'Buddilio credit − $5.96'; the only ₹ is the explicit 'about ₹83 in INR' FX hint. (5) USD defaults confirmed in admin event form (currency list starts with USD), partner event form, admin Add-a-country form; code-verified in AgreementsAdmin (net 20 / floor 20 USD), MyLedger and Cancellations. PayPal was never approved; no webhook button pressed. All data I created was removed.

critical.issue: totals.collected/commission/tax/payouts_* are raw sums of mixed-currency rows but the response says currency='USD'. Page-1 rows sum to 107,113.40 raw vs ~1,285.41 base-converted; the API reports collected=256,488.73 for the whole set, i.e. INR rows counted 83x. Rows DO carry a correct per-row `currency`, so apply the same to_base() pattern already used in partner_door_takings / settlement_totals.

gross_sales / membership_revenue / event_revenue / pass_revenue are mixed-currency raw sums with NO currency field; the admin dashboard stamps them with $ (GROSS SALES $214,853.61 on a platform whose USD orders are $1-$60). Convert to BASE_CURRENCY and return currency='USD'.

minor.issue: batch currency falls back to 'INR' (`items[0].get('currency','INR')`) and gross/commission/net are summed without FX conversion, so a batch mixing currencies would be wrong. Use BASE_CURRENCY as the fallback and convert before summing.

ui_bugs.issue: Historical INR rows are printed with $ (INV-BUDC4A9034A shows $1,591.94 although the order and its invoice are INR 1,591.94) and the stat cards read COLLECTED $256,488.73 / OUR COMMISSION $197,001.63. This is exactly the bug just fixed on the member orders list, one screen over. Use money(row.gross, row.currency) and base-converted totals.

GROSS SALES $214,853.61 / MEMBERSHIP REVENUE $65,042.02 / EVENT REVENUE $33,779.62 / PASS REVENUE $116,031.97 are INR-inflated mixed sums shown as USD (backend /admin/stats has no currency and no conversion).

Rows print every amount with $ regardless of the row currency: Payouts shows GROSS $8,863.64 / NET $7,534.09 for an INR payout row (API returns currency='INR'), and Orders shows membership $2,358.82 / $1,178.82 for INR orders. Cards PENDING AMOUNT $14,284.09 / SETTLED $24,464.70 are mixed sums.

ui_bugs.component: React console error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' - NOW REPRODUCED
ui_bugs.issue: Reproduced on the public /events page and on /partner. Cause: <option> children that mix static text with a JSX expression get wrapped by the preview instrumentation in <span style='display:contents'>. Offenders: Events.jsx line 64 `<option value={1000}>Under {fmt(1000)}</option>` (x3) and Partner.jsx line 188 `<option value={c.code}>{c.code} — {c.label}</option>`. Fix by making the label one single expression child, e.g. {`Under ${fmt(1000)}`} and {`${c.code} — ${c.label}`}.

Price filter offers 'Under $1,000 / $2,500 / $5,000' on a USD-base catalogue whose events cost $3.60-$65 - the filter is useless after the currency cleanup. Rescale the buckets (e.g. Under $25 / $50 / $100) or derive them from the catalogue max.

ui_bugs.component: Admin vs vendor settlement row formatting
ui_bugs.issue: Cosmetic inconsistency: admin prints rows as 'INR 1,900.00' (code prefix, VendorPayouts.jsx money()) while the vendor portal prints '₹1,900' (symbol, no decimals). Same data, two formats. Consider one shared money(value, currency) helper.

issues: 8 repeated console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' because a ResponsiveContainer renders inside a hidden/zero-size tab panel. Give the container a minHeight or render the chart only when its tab is active.
Leftover test data from an earlier testing run is still visible to the user: UTR 'TEST_UTR_80c294' and 'TEST_UTR_9c1e77' on paid payouts, and 'UTR-TEST-001' on the vendor settlements screen.

action_items: Convert /api/admin/ledger totals to BASE_CURRENCY before summing (rows already carry currency) and format each ledger row with money(row.gross, row.currency).
Convert /api/admin/stats money figures to BASE_CURRENCY, return currency='USD', and label the admin dashboard cards from it.
Admin > Payouts and Admin > Orders: print each row in its own currency and base-convert the stat cards.
Fix the '<span> inside <option>' React error by collapsing the mixed text+expression option labels into a single template-literal child (Events.jsx:64, Partner.jsx:188).
Rescale the Events price filter buckets (1000/2500/5000 are INR-era values).
vendor_routes.create_payout_runs: replace the 'INR' currency fallback and convert amounts before summing batch totals.
Purge leftover TEST_UTR_* / UTR-TEST-001 payout references from earlier test runs.
critical_code_review_comments: The mixed-currency aggregation anti-pattern is now fixed in 3 places (door takings, admin settlements, vendor settlements) but still live in /admin/ledger, /admin/stats and the payout-batch builder. Extract one shared async to_base(amount, currency) helper plus a single frontend money(value, currency) and use them everywhere instead of patching screen by screen.
server.py remains ~8,750 lines; currency/pricing helpers (BASE_CURRENCY, fx_rates, price_event, tax_for, checkout) still belong in their own module.

There is no DELETE for a member's pending order, so any checkout-path test leaks pending orders that then appear on the member's My-orders screen and in the admin Orders tab. Consider an abandon/cancel-pending endpoint.

success_rate.backend: 83% (10/12 new cases; both failures are the newly found ledger/stats defect) + 23/23 iteration-45 regressions
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 5 requested fixes verified; 4 new currency-labelling screens found broken

Verified fixed this run: Dashboard My-orders currency (₹1,592 INR / $6.96 USD, agrees with cancellation sheet and INR invoice), admin vendor-settlement USD cards with INR rows, vendor-portal settlement USD cards with ₹ rows (admin == vendor: paid 38.40, batched/pending 22.80), checkout credit sub-line in charge currency, USD defaults in admin event form / partner event form / add-a-country / agreements schedule. Use /app/backend/tests/i46_diag.py diag to dump orders/settlements by currency. The '<span> inside <option>' React error IS reproducible - visit /events or /partner with console capture.
rca_of_the_issue: All five iteration-45 fixes are genuinely implemented: Dashboard.jsx now calls money(o.charge_total ?? o.total, o.currency); vendor_routes.settlement_totals() and /vendor/settlements divide each row by its fx rate before summing and return currency=BASE_CURRENCY; VendorPayouts.jsx money() defaults to USD and cards read t.currency; Commerce.jsx uses amt() for the credit sub-line; every INR literal default was replaced with USD (only the CURRENCIES option list still contains INR, correctly, as a selectable value). The remaining defects are the identical anti-pattern in code paths the fix did not touch: /admin/ledger and /admin/stats sum `gross`/`total` across currencies and the admin Ledger/Dashboard/Payouts/Orders tables format with the base symbol regardless of row.currency. The previously unreproducible React '<span> in <option>' error was finally caught: it comes from option labels that mix literal text with a JSX expression, which the preview instrumentation wraps in a display:contents span.
